name: portal-forcer-overworld-floor
notes: An item goes through a nether portal in the Nether; PortalForcer.createPortal builds the exit in the void overworld on the only frame-capable spot: a 4x3 bedrock patch at y=-64. Asserts that the frame's bottom row turned the bedrock into obsidian.

script.state: execute in minecraft:the_nether run forceload add 0 0
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -3 98 -3 4 104 3 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -1 99 0 2 103 0 minecraft:obsidian
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill 0 100 0 1 102 0 minecraft:nether_portal[axis=x]
execute in minecraft:the_nether if block 0 100 0 minecraft:nether_portal
execute in minecraft:the_nether run summon minecraft:item 0.5 100.3 0.5 {Item:{id:"minecraft:stone",count:1},NoGravity:1b,PickupDelay:32767}
